recap.text: Administrator Mukta replaces Zev and overrides a booking for Dungeon Crawl Tactics to pick a program with a higher fee. Mukta threatens Carl and Princess Donut with acceleration if they refuse to take their seats on the Maestro's set. After the show, Zev returns from a time out and says Mukta should never have booked it.

Zev warns that Loita has a claim on the crawlers' account because she is Bloom. Carl files a precedent noting that their last substitute, the Mukta guy who put them on the Maestro's show, was also a member of the Bloom political party.

Zev reports over chat that one of Lucia Mar's dogs ate Administrator Mukta. Zev can still hear the screaming. Carl laughs out loud. Mukta was a kua-tin and the person who put the crawlers on the Maestro's show.

beats.headline: Zev is in a time out
beats.text: For the record: Mukta (Admin) opens a chat in a safe room in the kobold quadrant. Crawlers Carl and Princess Donut are to be transported to their interview in ten minutes. Their outreach associate has been put in a time out and returns tomorrow; Mukta is the substitute until then. Zev had them booked on Dungeon Crawl Tactics. Mukta has overridden her and picked a better program, one paying a higher fee. Still round-table style. Close enough. Crawler Carl says they were promised the right to refuse. "You seem to be under the impression that you have a say in this, crawler." The chat closes. It cannot be answered.
beats.gist: Administrator Mukta opens a chat in a safe room to substitute for Zev in a time out.

beats.headline: Sit, or be accelerated
beats.text: On the Maestro's set the crawlers refuse to take part, and a first voice threatens to drop them in the ocean. Crawler Carl calls bullshit. Then: "Crawler Carl, this is Administrator Mukta." They are required to take their seats. Refusal means acceleration; there are plenty of other crawlers to show; this is not a bluff. Asked whether that other guy can hear, a pause, then no. Asked whether anything he says carries consequences, provided he participates, a longer pause: "They have paid for your appearance. Nothing else."
beats.gist: Administrator Mukta tells Carl to sit or be accelerated on the Maestro's set.

beats.headline: Should never have booked it
beats.text: Mukta warned there would be a discussion after the show. The program ends, the crawlers are transported back, and there is no sign of the admin. Afterwards a warning arrives, no weapons in the presence of Admins, and Crawler Carl says "Mukta is coming." It is Zev who appears, her censure lifted on appeal. Her verdict on the Maestro's show: Mukta should never have booked it. Her own booking would have been a discussion of dungeon tactics, done in a creative, silly way. Borant, she adds, is not allowed to discriminate against Syndicate-member production companies.
beats.gist: Administrator Mukta warns of a discussion after the Maestro's show, but vanishes when the program ends.

beats.headline: A party member
beats.text: Zev warns that Loita has a claim on the crawlers' account. She is Bloom, and Zev is not. By Crawler Carl's understanding, Bloom is the kua-tin political party that runs Borant, and its members receive much better treatment. For the record, he files a precedent: the last substitute they had, "the Mukta guy" who put them on the Maestro's show, was a party member.
beats.gist: Carl files a precedent that Administrator Mukta, a Bloom party member, put them on the Maestro's show.

beats.headline: One of the two dogs
beats.text: Administrator Mukta, kua-tin, party member, is dead. Reported by Zev, over chat, after saying Lucia Mar no longer answers messages and was never her client, thank goodness: one of Lucia's dogs ate Mukta, back when she still had two. It was horrible. Mukta was an ass, and a party member, but nobody deserved that. Zev can still hear the screaming. Crawler Carl laughs out loud. File note: the second kua-tin the crawlers ever spoke with, and the one responsible for putting them on the Maestro's show in the first place.
beats.gist: Zev reports via chat that one of Lucia Mar's dogs ate Administrator Mukta.
